patch_description: This crossover retains the high-accuracy adaptive level-and-slope Kalman structure from the current implementation while restoring a lighter version of the reversal-confirmation logic from the prior trend-preserving implementation. The estimator uses robust MAD innovation scaling, bounded measurement updates, and adaptive process noise for responsive tracking. A hysteretic output stage suppresses isolated direction changes without fully freezing the signal, reducing false reversals and slope-change counts while preserving the low lag and tracking quality of the Kalman estimate. The basic moving-average path is also vectorized for lower latency.
